mapper.sql: r.id, r.name, r.direction, r.amount, r.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, r.account_id AS accountId, a.name AS accountName, r.from_account_id AS fromAccountId, fa.name AS fromAccountName, r.to_account_id AS toAccountId, ta.name AS toAccountName, r.sort_order AS sortOrder, r.enabled, r.note, r.create_by AS createBy, r.create_time AS createTime, r.update_by AS updateBy, r.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM finance_recurring r LEFT JOIN finance_category c ON c.id = r.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN finance_account a ON a.id = r.account_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN finance_account fa ON fa.id = r.from_account_id AND fa.deleted = 0 AND fa.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN finance_account ta ON ta.id = r.to_account_id AND ta.deleted = 0 AND ta.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.id = #{id} AND r.user_id = #{userId}
